properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret used to sign and verify JWTs.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated allowed browser origins. Defaults to the local Vite development server.

properties.name: app.admin.bootstrap.email
properties.description: Optional email for one-time administrator bootstrap from environment configuration.

properties.name: app.admin.bootstrap.name
properties.description: Display name for the initial administrator.

properties.name: app.admin.bootstrap.password
properties.description: Optional initial administrator password; existing admin passwords are never replaced.

properties.name: app.ai.api-key
properties.description: Optional OpenAI API key used for embedding and grounded answer generation.

properties.name: app.ai.chat-model
properties.description: OpenAI chat completion model for RAG answers.

properties.name: app.ai.embedding-model
properties.description: OpenAI embedding model for document and query vectors.
